text: Greg Davies tells Nick Mohammed that "the umbrella wink" is going to catch on, after the Put the watermelon on this table task, in which Nick winks directly at the camera almost every time that he says the word 'umbrella'.

name: Steve Pemberton
text: Steve Pemberton tells Alex Horne that he’ll see him at "Assistantbury", during the Create a new tradition to celebrate Assistant's Day task.

name: Sophie Willan
text: Sophie Willan explains to Greg Davies that her character of "Cosmic Rhythm" is providing "Ambience and information" during the Present the best new short-form shiny floor American gameshow task.

name: Greg Davies
text: Greg Davies claims that Alex Horne calls the members of the show’s production crew "the faceless facilitators of his genius", during studio discussion of Jack Dee’s attempt at the Do the most beautiful thing with bubbles task.

name: Greg Davies
text: Greg Davies notes that Babatunde Aléshé had "labelled the orcas the gangsters of the sea" after Babatunde decided to refer to an orca as a "killer whale" because "that sounds gangster", during his attempt at the Put a rocket in your pocket task.

quote: I'm a girl who likes a clean line
name: Emma Sidi
text: Emma Sidi states that "I’m a girl that likes a clean line" during studio discussion of her attempt at the Pick the Taskmaster's locket from its pocket task.

name: Emma Sidi
text: Emma Sidi states that she just loves "Big stupid things", during studio discussion of her reaction to seeing Alex Horne dressed as a robot for the Direct the robot to its charging station task.

quote: A dance as old as time itself
name: Andy Zaltzman
text: Andy Zaltzman states that it’s "A dance as old as time itself", after Greg Davies says "It's between a talking shit and a murderous pigeon", while ruminating on the scores for the Create the most charismatic new children's television puppet sidekick for Alex task.

name: Rosie Jones
text: Rosie Jones sings "Captain Jackie and the hot dog" during the Work out what is in the box task, in reference to her team’s appearance at that time.

name: Andy Zaltzman
text: Andy Zaltzman repeatedly labels his own groin "The Nexus of Truth" during the Do these three things again and again and again in that same order task.

name: Greg Davies
text: Greg Davies states that he had imagined himself as "one of the cockle children of the Thames", while looking at Jack Dee’s dirty artwork and listening to Emma Sidi’s "haunting song", during studio discussion of the Clean the most profound picture of majestic nature on a dirty thing task.

name: Rosie Jones
text: Rosie Jones announces "Je vous… presente… Le Goose", at the start of her attempt at the Present "The Goose" task.

name: Alex Horne
text: Alex Horne claims that he has been known to "Sometimes spit", when asked by Jason Mantzoukas what cool things he does, during the Do your cool thing backwards task.

name: Jason Mantzoukas
text: Jason Mantzoukas suggests that everyone "Imagine there’s an invisible jump rope in there", before footage of Stevie Martin’s strange jumping gait during the Give Alex exactly 100 marbles on a plate and an eggcup full of tepid water task is replayed yet again on the screen, in the studio.

name: Mathew Baynton
text: Mathew Baynton states that "It was not my intention to upstage Stevie with my, presumably, scrotum" after watching his own attempt at the Answer the cheese phone task.

name: Greg Davies
text: Greg Davies sarcastically says "I’m so sorry to interrupt the children’s midnight picnic", when Jason Mantzoukas and Stevie Martin decide to sit on the stage floor to confer over their guesses to the Convince the other team that the following things are the opposite of what they are task.

name: Greg Davies
text: Greg Davies suggests that "Maybe we're the monsters!" during his end of episode sign-off, referencing Rosie Ramsey’s mistaken belief that the contestants were meant to draw themselves during the Draw the monster task.

name: Jason Mantzoukas
text: Jason Mantzoukas says "Oh, whatever it is, it’s got to be obsolete", while mocking Alex Horne’s choice to study Latin and Greek at Cambridge University, during the Teach the Taskmaster's Assistant a lesson he'll never forget task.

name: Rosie Ramsey
text: Rosie Ramsey says "Glass half most" whilst choosing between writing the word 'most' or 'least' during the Eat this yoghurt with the most/least dignity task, presumably trying to convey that she’s making her choice because she’s an optimist.

name: Mathew Baynton
text: Mathew Baynton sings "science all your life" as part of his improvised theme tune to the 'Science Today' show, during the Obey the autocue task.

name: Jason Mantzoukas
text: Jason Mantzoukas refers to Alex Horne’s legs as "getaway sticks" at the start of the Create the most exciting new bodies so that you and Alex become a dynamic duo task.

name: Greg Davies
text: After Greg Davies describes Jason Mantzoukas’s stalling tactic during the Provide the best drive-through experience task as "So clever", and Alex Horne claims that they’ve "not seen that side of you before", Jason asks, incredulously, "The clever side?".
